_doc: Traits unlock when personality stats cross thresholds (every entry in 'unlock' must hold) and stay unlocked. 'passive' is the small bonus: 'profile' adds to KickProfile fields (same keys as modifiers.json effects); 'gains' multiplies stat gains, keyed by a group (life/football/personality) or a single stat (e.g. resilience), +0.15 = 15% bigger gains; 'miss_streak' scales how much a miss streak adds to pressure (-0.3 = 30% less). 'unlocks' is shown on the Stats & Traits screen; scenarios name the traits they require.

traits.name: Fan Favorite
traits.description: The crowd is on your side.
traits.unlocks: Autograph signing, podcast guest, awards show scenarios

traits.name: Team Captain
traits.description: Teammates follow your lead, and you don't rattle.
traits.unlocks: Mentoring, press conference, team meeting scenarios

traits.name: Media Savvy
traits.description: Knows what to say to a camera.
traits.unlocks: Sponsor photo shoot and interview scenarios

traits.name: Community Pillar
traits.description: Gives back, and it gives back to you.
traits.unlocks: Community service, charity event, youth kicking camp scenarios
